why: The ferry's teleport moved to tick 30 of its own sequence, inside the cutscene the crossing plays at the landing from tick 23. The cutscene's end puts every player back on the marker it saved when it started, so a carry made while the camera is out is undone the moment it returns. It declares no unit: `at_ticks` is bound by the primary. The refusal names the tick the cutscene ends at and the first tick that holds.
